blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — The San Antonio Spurs rallied from 22 points down to beat the Chicago Bulls 124-119 on Wednesday, notching a 10th straight NBA win and keeping the pressure on the league-leading Los Angeles Lakers. The Lakers improved their league-best record to 11-2 —half a game ahead of the 10-2 Spurs atop the West — with a 123-112 victory over the Bucks in Milwaukee. Luka Doncic scored 32 points but limped out late in the fourth quarter after rolling his right ankle.
